column auth.tb_password_credential.created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
column auth.tb_password_credential.disabled_at timestamp with time zone null
column auth.tb_password_credential.fk_user bigint not null
column auth.tb_password_credential.id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
column auth.tb_password_credential.password_hash text not null
column auth.tb_password_credential.pk_password_credential bigint not null
column auth.tb_password_credential.tenant_id uuid null
column auth.tb_password_credential.updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
column auth.tb_password_credential.user_id text not null
index CREATE INDEX idx_password_credential_user_id ON auth.tb_password_credential USING btree (user_id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tb_password_credential_fk_user_key ON auth.tb_password_credential USING btree (fk_user)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tb_password_credential_pkey ON auth.tb_password_credential USING btree (pk_password_credential)
policy auth.tb_password_credential p_password_credential_insert permissive to {public} for insert using - check true
policy auth.tb_password_credential p_password_credential_tenant_read permissive to {public} for select using (tenant_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('fraiseql.tenant_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) check -
row level security auth.tb_password_credential on
